project_name: Prime Data Centers Austin Campus / Project Snow
status_detail: Caldwell County Commissioners Court announced incentives for a 206-acre data center campus at FM 2720 and Bob White Road; Phase 1 is $1.3B for three 262,000-sf two-story buildings, with nine data centers and $4.2B capex at full buildout.
notes: County Feb. 26, 2026 recap says Prime Data Center remained in economic development negotiations; EDA article provides site, phase, and abatement details.

status_detail: Tract owns and is developing a 2,973-acre master-planned data center mega-campus with 4,000 MW listed capacity and site energization targeted in 2028; earlier acquisition release said 1,515 acres supported over 2 GW with initial 360 MW energization in 2028.
notes: County recap identifies Tract's Caldwell Valley Technology Park north of Lockhart as a 3,000-acre AI/cloud campus with over 4 GW capacity.

status_detail: Caldwell County Commissioners unanimously approved development agreements for an Edged Energy-owned and operated campus in the Maxwell area on about 330 acres off SH 142 near LCRA Timmerman Power Plant; projected improvements total $7.3B.
notes: County source is primary for approval and site; DCD adds TDLR filing context for a roughly 2M-sf campus.

status_detail: PowerHouse Data Centers is seeking to build a roughly 500-acre facility in Caldwell Valley Technology Park and filed a petition to release the proposed facility from Uhland jurisdiction to county jurisdiction.
notes: Included as a separate lead because the developer is distinct from Tract's land platform; sparse details and likely within the broader Caldwell Valley site.

project_name: Crusoe / Blue Energy Port of Victoria AI factory campus
aliases: Blue Energy-Crusoe Calhoun County AI campus
Port of Victoria nuclear-powered AI data center
status_detail: Crusoe and Blue Energy announced a strategic partnership for a nuclear-powered AI data center campus; Blue Energy secured a site for up to 1.5 GW advanced nuclear plant serving Crusoe AI factories, with gas bridge power as early as 2028 and nuclear generation expected by 2031.
notes: Crusoe correction explicitly says the 1,600-acre Crusoe campus is in Calhoun County, not Victoria County; power plant tax-break filing is reported separately.

project_name: Callahan County / Big Country data center construction
status_detail: KTXS published drone-video coverage of a sprawling data center construction site tagged and captioned as Callahan County, with ongoing earthmoving, foundations, utilities, and vertical building work visible; no official completion date was announced.
notes: Caution: article URL/caption/topics say Callahan County, but the article headline/body also say Shackelford County. Kept under Callahan because batch search surfaced this county-specific lead; developer and exact site not identified.

status_detail: Eneus Energy is pursuing a 2 GW campus in Cameron County near Valley International Airport/Harlingen, with 16 data halls over about 1,785 acres and a planned 765 kV transmission line; county judge said no permit applications had been filed as of January 2026.
notes: RGV Business Journal reports Eneus sued Cameron County and the Texas AG to block release of project records tied to timelines, water, power demand, incentives, land ownership, and communications.

status_detail: Soluna is planning a 100 MW data center at a 145 MW wind farm in Cameron County for bitcoin mining and AI workloads; the specific wind farm has not been disclosed.
notes: Reported as part of Soluna's Rio Grande Valley wind-powered data center expansion; not the Willacy County Kati site.

status_detail: Soluna is planning a 120 MW data center at a 200 MW wind farm in Cameron County for bitcoin mining and AI workloads; the specific wind farm has not been disclosed.
notes: Reported as a separate Cameron County Soluna project alongside Project Ellen.

project_name: Metrobloks Harlingen / South Texas AI-ready campus lead
status_detail: Metrobloks public site describes MFE-A / Project Kati 2 as a 350 MW total critical IT South Texas campus near McAllen, while KRGV reported Cameron County concerns and a Harlingen Waterworks reclaimed-water agreement regarding a data center; county judge said the company looking near Valley International Airport had not filed permits.
notes: County assignment is uncertain: Metrobloks' MFE-A appears tied to Soluna Project Kati 2 in Willacy County/near McAllen, but local KRGV coverage links Metrobloks discussion to Cameron County/Harlingen. Included as a low-confidence lead to avoid omission.
